_comment: Reviewed Black Dragon adapters: read-only repo tools run on the task through _black_dragon_exec.py. Each was run by hand and exits 0 without writing outside the job. Execution still needs --execute-adapters. Media adapters ("media": true) run real video/audio tools through _black_dragon_media.py on --media FILE, or on a self-test clip with known answers when no file is given; their outputs stay inside the job. Skill adapters ("skill_program": true) run the script a skill ships through _black_dragon_skill.py and check its output. Tool adapters ("tool_suite": true) run through _black_dragon_tool.py: the tool's own registered test files run against its real code, or, for a tool with no tests, a known-answer recipe on a fixture (checkers must catch a planted flaw); they do not run the tool on the task text.
